test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the new geospatial planning portal launched by the Union Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Sri Giriraj Singh in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuktdhara.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• With the aid of** remote sensing and GIS-based data**, th**e Ministry of Rural Development** has introduced a **new geospatial planning site, "Yuktdhara,"** to facilitate the new **MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) assets.**
 
• The new portal is located under **"Bhuvan."**
 
• It is the result of cooperative work by the** Ministry of Rural Development** and **ISRO **to establish a** G2G (Government-to-Government**) service for rural planning in support of decentralized decision-making.
 
• Along with the **field photos,** it will act as a repository for the assets (geotags) produced by the various **National Rural Development Programs,** including **MGNREGA, Per Drop More Crop Programs, Integrated Watershed Management Program, and Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana.**
 
• It integrates a wide variety of** thematic layers, multi-temporal high resolution earth observation data** with analysis tools. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhuvan:**

 
 
• Bhuvan,** ISRO’s geo-portal,** is providing **visualisation services and Earth observation data** to users in the public domain.
 
• Besides, the portal also services several users for their r**emote sensing application needs. ​**
